name: Replace with the benchmark name
notes: Every case must declare label_status. Use event-evidence when positive events are documented but the surrounding interval is not proven quiet; confirmed-quiet only for independently verified negative coverage; fully-labelled only when both positive and negative coverage are authoritative; unknown for unverified periods.

cases.description: Replace with the object and observation-window description.
cases.source: Public URL, DOI, mission report, operator notice, or other ground-truth citation.

truth_events.label: Documented maneuver
truth_events.source: Specific source for this event, or omit to use the case source.
